description_full: Messier 42 is a diffuse nebula in the Milky Way situated south of Orion's Belt in the constellation of Orion,[b] and is known as the middle 'star' in the 'sword' of Orion. It is 1,267.0 ± 5.4 light-years (388.5 ± 1.7 pc) away. M42 is estimated to be 25 light-years across.
The Pleiades, also known as Seven Sisters and Messier 45 (M45), is an open star cluster containing young B-type stars in the constellation Taurus.
The Leo Triplet (also known as the M66 Group) is a small group of galaxies about 35 million light-years away in the constellation Leo.
